newsitem.title: PERU: Peruvian youths riot at detention center.
newsitem.headline: Peruvian youths riot at detention center.

text.p: About 100 youths rioted at a Peruvian juvenile detention centre on Tuesday to protest alleged bad conditions and torture by their guards.
"We have no water, they beat us," one of the youths shouted from the roof of the institution as other inmates burned mattresses, tossed stones and waved T-shirts.

The prisoners at the Maranga detention centre in Lima ended their five-hour protest after public prosecutors entered the institution to hear their complaints. They asked for a new director for the centre and an end to alleged mistreatment such as the use of electric shocks and tiny, underground punishment rooms infested with rats and sewage.
None of the center's officials responded immediately to the charges.

Local mayor Marina Sequeiros blamed the riot on older inmates who, she said, should have been transferred from the juvenile centre when they turned 18 but were kept there because they had no identification documents. "Those are the ones who cause the problems," she said.
